title: #003. Coin Change Puzzle
subtitle: Use integer variables with upper bounds and an equality constraint to minimize total coins.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { counts, totalCoins }.
judge.m3: Total amount ({p0}) does not equal targetAmount ({p1}).
judge.m4: Reported totalCoins ({p0}) does not match computed coin count ({p1}).
judge.m5: Feasible change, but totalCoins ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
